heading: Scholarly Attribution & Citation
description: Provenance, manuscript shelfmarks, and academic citation formats for digital scholarly editions of Old English interlinear texts.
booktitle: Glossy: Digital Scholarly Editions of Old English Interlinear Texts
attributionLinguisticPackage: LaTeX gb4e with Leipzig Three-Tier Interlinear Glossing
attributionStandardsStatement: Developed through the collaborative partnership of Ariel Anders (software architecture, digital platform, and automated verification suite) and Tyler Lemon (linguistic subject matter expertise, Old English glossing, and grammatical accuracy). Interlinear formatting conforms to the international Leipzig Glossing Rules with LaTeX gb4e alignment, canonical lemmatization referenced to Bosworth-Toller and Wiktionary, and visual gloss layout inspired by Peter S. Baker's Old English Aerobics (oldenglishaerobics.net).
